subject: Bumping along on a bumpity road...
author: SUFFUR
body:
that made my bum go bumity bump, in a car that bumpitied over the bumpity road, to bump a bump that broke the hump on the goose bumped camel from the bump on the hill, where a boy called Kev goes dribble dribble boing, as his heart goes bumpity bump, where's the rump?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: REVENGE ONLINE....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
😃 So happy to see a Revenge related FAQ.......and the answer is exactly how xandu put it ''YES IT IS''..👏...so if anyone fancys this old time classic game its really cheap now and is still as much fun as it ever was..⭐....so if youve never tried this game on the XBOX 360.....i highly recommend that you do.....❤️or if youve played the game and it was like years ago wipe of the excess dust and reload your adrenalin....''AND GET READY FOR REVENGE''...🎵
